pluginLoopSelector.hint: Plugin LLM tools default to Work only. You can explicitly allow Conversation only or both loops; plugin commands are outside this tool route.
pluginLoopSelector.empty: There are no enabled non-system plugins.

capabilityLoopSelector.mcpHint: MCP tools default to Work only. Expose a server to the conversation loop only when it is appropriate for chat-time use.
capabilityLoopSelector.emptyMcp: There are no enabled MCP servers.
capabilityLoopSelector.skillHint: Skills default to both loops. Workspace Skills remain available only to the work loop. Workspace Skills remain work-only with the local runtime.

codingAgentsEditor.hint: Each entry names a local CLI agent the work loop hands writes to. Only enabled agents are used, and only while the work loop's Computer Use runtime is local. The permission mode and the sandbox are policies the CLI itself enforces, not operating-system isolation, so bypassPermissions and danger-full-access have to be chosen deliberately.
codingAgentsEditor.empty: No coding agent yet. Add one to let the work loop delegate writes.
codingAgentsEditor.disabledWarning: A disabled agent is not offered to the work loop.
codingAgentsEditor.agentIdHint: A unique name for this agent. It names the generated CLI config files, so prefer letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores.
codingAgentsEditor.missingIdWarning: An agent without an ID is ignored when the configuration is read.
codingAgentsEditor.duplicateIdWarning: Another agent already uses this ID; the later one is ignored when the configuration is read.
codingAgentsEditor.commandHint: The executable to run. Empty uses the command shown as the placeholder.
codingAgentsEditor.missingCommandWarning: A custom agent without a command is ignored when the configuration is read.
codingAgentsEditor.modelHint: Empty uses the active preset's model.
codingAgentsEditor.permissionModeHint: Passed to Claude Code as --permission-mode. A delegated run is non-interactive, so it approves edits only: a task that runs shell commands waits for a confirmation nothing can give. Choose bypassPermissions deliberately when the task needs them.
codingAgentsEditor.riskyPermissionWarning: bypassPermissions lets the CLI run without asking. Only use it where the task folder can be discarded.
codingAgentsEditor.riskySandboxWarning: danger-full-access removes the Codex sandbox. Only use it where the task folder can be discarded.
codingAgentsEditor.projectDirHint: An optional absolute path added to the run. Empty keeps writes inside the task folder.
codingAgentsEditor.extraArgsHint: Passed before the flags AstrBot manages, so a managed flag always wins.
codingAgentsEditor.envHint: Added to the child process only. One NAME=value per entry.
codingAgentsEditor.providersHint: The active preset's endpoint and model take effect as this CLI's own config layer. Its key is passed only in the child's environment, never written to disk.
codingAgentsEditor.providersCustomHint: A custom CLI does not read a generated config layer; give it credentials through Environment instead.
codingAgentsEditor.noProviders: No preset. The CLI falls back to the account you already signed in with.
codingAgentsEditor.activeProviderHint: The preset handed to this CLI.
codingAgentsEditor.providerApiKeyHint: Passed to the child process for the length of the run and never written to the configuration.
codingAgentsEditor.providerWireApiHint: Codex only. "responses" is the default; "chat" selects the chat completions API.

btwPage.title: BTW Dual Loop
btwPage.subtitle: The conversation loop answers and the work loop carries out longer tasks. The work loop reads and plans: anything that has to write is handed to a coding agent running in a task folder of its own.
btwPage.appliesToHint: Which configuration profile these settings are saved to.
btwPage.loadError: Could not load the BTW settings.
btwPage.metadataMissing: This build does not describe the BTW settings, so there is nothing to edit here.
btwPage.saveError: Could not save the BTW settings
btwPage.twoFactorRejected: That code was not accepted. Enter the current one.
btwPage.unsavedMessage: Leaving now discards them. The work loop's boundary is among what would be lost.

cliConfigPage.title: CLI Provider Switching
cliConfigPage.subtitle: Keep a list of providers for Claude Code and Codex, and switch a CLI to one of them. Switching writes that provider into the CLI's own configuration, so the CLI uses it everywhere -- including the sessions you start by hand.
cliConfigPage.untouchedHint: A delegated coding task is not affected: it layers its own configuration over these files instead of reading them, so switching a provider here never changes how a task runs.
cliConfigPage.loadError: Could not read the CLI configuration.
cliConfigPage.fileAbsent: The file does not exist yet and will be created on the first switch.
cliConfigPage.noProviders: No provider yet. Add one to be able to switch this CLI.
cliConfigPage.providerIdHint: A unique name for this provider. It names the stored credential, so prefer letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores.
cliConfigPage.baseUrlHintClaude: For example https://api.example.com -- written as ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL.
cliConfigPage.baseUrlHintCodex: For example https://api.example.com/v1 -- written as the Codex provider's base_url.
cliConfigPage.apiKeyHint: Stored in the CLI's own configuration file on this host, readable only by you. Leave empty when editing to keep the stored key.
cliConfigPage.modelHint: Optional. Written as the CLI's default model.
cliConfigPage.saveError: Could not save the provider list
cliConfigPage.endpointOrKeyRequired: A provider needs an endpoint or an API key.
cliConfigPage.idTaken: Another provider already uses this ID.
cliConfigPage.switchMessage: This rewrites the file the CLI reads on this host, including the stored key. Your previous file is kept once as a backup, and “Take back” restores it.
cliConfigPage.deleteMessage: It is removed from the list. If the CLI is currently using it, the file it wrote is left as it is until you switch or take it back.
cliConfigPage.restoreMessage: The file is restored from the backup taken before the first switch, if there is one.
cliConfigPage.switched: Switched. The CLI now uses this provider.
cliConfigPage.switchError: Could not switch the CLI's provider.
cliConfigPage.restoreError: Could not restore the CLI configuration.
cliConfigPage.unsavedMessage: Leaving now discards the changes to the list.
